commit.message: Better checks for .diz files in test.

8375623: Filter .diz and .debuginfo files in StripNativeDebugSymbolsPlugin

When jlink is called with --strip-debug (or --strip-native-debug-symbols
exclude-debuginfo-files), pre-existing native debug sidecar files
(.debuginfo and .diz) from the source runtime image are now dropped from
the output image. Previously they passed through the resource pool
unchanged, resulting in large files like libjvm.debuginfo appearing in
the linked image despite --strip-debug being specified.

The fix checks for .debuginfo/.diz path suffixes before the binary-stripping
branch so that both NATIVE_LIB and NATIVE_CMD typed sidecars are dropped.
Sidecars are only dropped when includeDebugSymbols is false (i.e. the
exclude-debuginfo-files configuration, which is what --strip-debug uses).

Test coverage is extended in StripNativeDebugSymbolsPluginTest to verify
that both NATIVE_LIB and NATIVE_CMD .debuginfo/.diz entries are dropped
on exclude, and preserved on keep-debuginfo-files.
